name: Storepex – Herroepingsknop for WooCommerce
author: damienvos

sections.description:
Storepex – Herroepingsknop for WooCommerce helps Dutch WooCommerce stores offer and record digital withdrawal requests. It creates a regular WordPress page named “Herroepingsverzoek”, adds withdrawal buttons to WooCommerce order pages, records submitted requests as WooCommerce order notes, and sends confirmation emails to the customer and store administrator.

The plugin is intended for Dutch WooCommerce stores that need a process for offering and recording withdrawal requests. It is designed to support the administrative workflow around the Dutch right of withdrawal for distance sales, but it does not provide legal advice, determine eligibility, or guarantee compliance.

The plugin:

  • creates a regular published WordPress page containing the withdrawal form;
  • shows an order-specific request link on the order received page and individual order details page;
  • verifies the order ID and the billing email address;
  • stores the submitted request as a private order note;
  • records the submission date and time using the WordPress site timezone;
  • sends the request details to the configured store address;
  • sends the customer an email confirmation containing the submitted details.

New installations create a published page named “Herroepingsverzoek” with the slug herroepingsverzoek. The page uses the normal page layout supplied by the active theme. Depending on the theme configuration, newly published pages may appear automatically in navigation; administrators can adjust this through the WordPress menu or Navigation editor.

The [hknl_herroepingsformulier] shortcode remains available for a custom form page. The [hknl_herroepingsknop] shortcode remains available for deliberate manual placement.

The plugin records and confirms requests. It does not determine whether a request is timely, valid, eligible, or legally enforceable. Store owners remain responsible for legal review, their withdrawal and return policy, customer information duties, retention periods, communication, and handling requests. This plugin is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance with any law or regulation.

The plugin contains no premium upsell, advertising, tracking code, or external API integration.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or later.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce 8.2 or later.

Privacy

When a customer submits the form, the plugin processes the order ID, name, email address, selected products or services, and an optional comment.

This data is:

  • used to match the request to a WooCommerce order;
  • stored as a private note on that order;
  • emailed to the configured store address;
  • used to send a receipt confirmation to the customer.

The plugin does not place tracking cookies or send data to external APIs. Site owners remain responsible for providing appropriate privacy information and defining access and retention policies.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for “Storepex – Herroepingsknop for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Herroepingsknop.
  6. Review the generated “Herroepingsverzoek” page and the notification email address.
  7. Test the complete workflow with a test order before using it on a production store.

You can also install the plugin manually by downloading the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org and uploading it through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
sections.faq:
Does activation create a WordPress page?

Yes. The plugin creates a regular published page named “Herroepingsverzoek” containing [hknl_herroepingsformulier].

Why can the “Herroepingsverzoek” page appear in my navigation?

The plugin creates a regular published WordPress page named “Herroepingsverzoek”. Depending on your active theme, this page may automatically appear as a link or button in the site navigation. If you do not want this navigation link, for example because it does not fit your site layout, remove it manually.

For classic themes, go to Appearance > Menus, open your main menu, remove “Herroepingsverzoek” from the menu, and click “Save Menu”.

For block themes, go to Appearance > Editor > Navigation, select the “Herroepingsverzoek” link, remove it, and click “Save”.

The withdrawal buttons on the order received page and the individual order details page will continue to work.

Does the plugin decide whether a customer has a right to withdraw?

No. The plugin only records and confirms the request. The store owner reviews the request and handles the next steps.

Where is the request action displayed?

The order-specific withdrawal button is displayed on the order received page and the individual order details page.

Does the plugin send data to external services?

The plugin does not call an external API and does not add tracking. Email is sent through the standard WordPress mail function. The website’s mail configuration may use an external email provider selected by the site owner.

What is removed when the plugin is uninstalled?

The plugin settings and page marker are removed. Existing pages and private order notes remain in place to avoid deleting store records or administrator-created content.
